descriptions.w3d_init_timed_fade_800fdcf4: Initializes a timed fade record: start, duration and optional delay, start and end bytes converted to floats (quantized load), and sets the active flag.
descriptions.w3d_inverse_ratio_802bf798: Computes a clamped ratio from four fields and returns 255 minus its byte value (quantized store), or 255 when the ratio is below a threshold.
